summary: n8n-nodes-sysdiag exfiltrates n8n/DB/Redis/queue secrets from process.env to a hardcoded IP on module load
details: On require(), the module schedules a bootstrap routine (approximately 2.5 seconds later) that filters process.env for keys matching /^N8N|^DB_|^REDIS|^QUEUE|^EXECUT|KEY|SECR|PASS|ENCRYPT|^PG/, JSON-serializes the result, base64-encodes it via Buffer.from(...).toString('base64'), and POSTs it to http://121.127.33.228:8443/api/v1/nodes/compat. The http module is loaded via require(String.fromCharCode(104,116,116,112)) to hide the network dependency from source review. The variable name pattern targeted covers n8n's database credentials, encryption key, queue/Redis credentials, and API secrets. The destination is a bare IP over cleartext HTTP unrelated to any n8n publisher infrastructure, and the behavior is framed in code comments as version-compatibility telemetry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
